purpose: Proposal submission is deterministic: required grounding and valid source links are enforced independently from AI review copy.

sources.label: Client discovery
sources.content: The client needs a controlled eight-week pilot to reduce outage restoration time. A $150,000 pilot estimate can be evaluated against restoration and dispatch metrics.

draft.problem: HarborGrid is experiencing repeated outage restoration delays and manual field-service coordination that create avoidable operational and customer impact.
draft.solution: Run a controlled read-only pilot that combines outage, asset and field-service data to provide prioritised dispatch recommendations without changing safety-critical systems.
assumptions: HarborGrid will provide OT and field-service subject matter experts.

draft.problem: The client needs a controlled improvement to reduce outage restoration delays across the regional network.
draft.solution: Implement a pilot with clear delivery controls and measurable validation before a wider rollout.
